original.target_description: Experiment 3, first test-block median log RTs for correct trials: mixed ANOVA of test group (factor versus multiply) and problem type (factored during practice, multiplied during practice, or new); Group × Problem Type interaction, p. 552 (PDF p. 7).

n.sample_role: Participants in mutually exclusive test-operation groups: 18 factor-at-test and 18 multiply-at-test; problem type is within participants.
n.exclusions: RT analysis uses correct trials in the first test block. No participant exclusion or reduced group size is reported in Experiment 3 Method/Results.
n.location: Experiment 3, Participants and General Procedure and Design, p. 551 (PDF p. 6); Test Phase, Response times, p. 552 (PDF p. 7).
n.quote: Two groups of 18 volunteers (26 women, 10 men) ... One group constituted the ... factor-at-test group and the other, the multiply-at-test group. ... The median of log RTs for correct trials in the ... first block of the test phase received a 2 ⫻ 3 mixed ANOVA

notes: Only n_o is assigned; all other fields are unassigned placeholders. Analytic participant N is documented group sum: 18 + 18 = 36. The groups are mutually exclusive factor-at-test and multiply-at-test groups; both enter the critical 2 × 3 mixed ANOVA. Trial role: correct response trials, first test block only; no participant exclusions reported. N is not derived from degrees of freedom or sex counts. Target identified from Experiment 3 and test-phase operation/problem-type description, not row order or numeric matching. Rendered PDF pp. 6–7 inspected for column order. No effect-size or p-field completion attempted.
